     1	"""Parsing of structured log lines.
     2	
     3	A line has the shape:
     4	
     5	    <timestamp> <LEVEL> key=value key="quoted value" ...
     6	
     7	The timestamp is an ISO-8601 string. The level is one of DEBUG, INFO, WARN,
     8	ERROR. Fields are key=value pairs separated by spaces; a value may be wrapped
     9	in double quotes when it contains spaces.
    10	"""
    11	
    12	from __future__ import annotations
    13	
    14	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    15	from typing import Iterable, Iterator
    16	
    17	LEVELS = ("DEBUG", "INFO", "WARN", "ERROR")
    18	
    19	
    20	class ParseError(ValueError):
    21	    """Raised when a line does not match the expected shape."""
    22	
    23	
    24	@dataclass(frozen=True)
    25	class LogRecord:
    26	    timestamp: str
    27	    level: str
    28	    fields: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    29	
    30	
    31	def _split_fields(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    32	    fields: dict[str, str] = {}
    33	    for token in text.split(" "):
    34	        if not token:
    35	            continue
    36	        if "=" not in token:
    37	            raise ParseError(f"field without '=': {token!r}")
    38	        key, value = token.split("=", 1)
    39	        if value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"') and len(value) >= 2:
    40	            value = value[1:-1]
    41	        fields[key] = value
    42	    return fields
    43	
    44	
    45	def parse_line(line: str) -> LogRecord:
    46	    """Parse one log line into a LogRecord.
    47	
    48	    Raises ParseError if the line is malformed.
    49	    """
    50	    stripped = line.strip()
    51	    if not stripped:
    52	        raise ParseError("empty line")
    53	    parts = stripped.split(" ", 2)
    54	    if len(parts) < 2:
    55	        raise ParseError(f"expected '<timestamp> <LEVEL> ...', got {line!r}")
    56	    timestamp, level = parts[0], parts[1]
    57	    if level not in LEVELS:
    58	        raise ParseError(f"unknown level {level!r}")
    59	    rest = parts[2] if len(parts) == 3 else ""
    60	    return LogRecord(timestamp=timestamp, level=level, fields=_split_fields(rest))
    61	
    62	
    63	def parse_lines(lines: Iterable[str]) -> Iterator[LogRecord]:
    64	    """Parse many lines, skipping blank ones."""
    65	    for line in lines:
    66	        if not line.strip():
    67	            continue
    68	        yield parse_line(line)
